item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I completely understand where you're coming from, and I was a bit worried about that as I was writing. However, I wanted to show the darker side of the Foundation; those references are meant to show that an invention created to allow people relive good memories could be used for evil, and how the Foundation might "overreact" to incomplete and/or inaccurate information on the nature of such an object. I know that these topics are still very sensitive, but what I am trying to say is that I did put a lot of thought into whether or not to reference them; they weren't just included for "shock value".

TL;DR: I totally respect and understand how you feel and why you feel that way, but I wasn't trying to make light of these events at all.
